items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: The Dorsey Brothers hadn't come there then.

ctx.x: And did Fletcher see Duke as a threat, an upcoming rival?

No, see, it wasn't so many bands in New York then, like it turned out later. Because, after that, they started coming in all directions, far and wide, far and wide. Big bands started opening up. The Dorsey Brothers hadn't come there then. Benny Goodman wasn't thought of, and Harry James wasn't thought of.
Well, a lot of big bands, they came later. And all on the strength of Fletcher having a big band. Well, naturally, some of those bands had more backing than he had, and they could make it, see.
